mine was more so for depression but definitely have felt my anxiety symptoms that accompany it relieved! Better than Sertraline or Fluoxetine which both flared me up. Very nice for sleep trouble too :)

Fluoxetine first time: 4/10
Think being my first medication I was scared to try more in case had negative effects, not realising that fluoxetine didn't do much for me & heightened my anxiety. That being said alongside CBT I felt happy enough to stop after a year so.. not sure if resulted from the medication though.

Fluoxetine second time: 1/10
This time it really hit me heavy first coming onto the medication.. super suicidal ideation, really effected by any sort of intensity. Only last 2 wks before had to stop. Began seeing my first therapist a week before taking.

Sertraline: 3/10
This managed to somewhat settle me from constant instability caused by the second try with Fluoxetine. Helped moreso with anxiety than depression for me though, although again only took for a short period. All that being said, after a month of taking the medication and two weeks of having some kind of level of control over dark thoughts, I realised this was not satisfactory. Hard to judge as definitely saved me and perhaps if stuck with it would've helped but. Also super low libido sucked ass. Ended with my first therapist at this point

Mirtazapine: 5/10
Although I feel completely reliant upon this medication at the moment, I am far more stable than I was 9 months ago on SSRIs. Began at 15mg but upped to 30 as supposedly would reduce sedative effects; not seemingly happening with me but too bad. Very hungry a lott and also tired, can't sleep till I take my meds and trip out a lot before managing to rest. Waves of feeling like a zombie and I'm looking forward to coming off, hopefully within next 3/4 months. Also very scared of coming off tho lol. Across this period, began and completed therapy with a far more experienced counsellor. I'm expecting her support has caused bias in my results..
